lanes.summary: The diff implements exactly what PMAT-3445 requires: a script to verify that a release milestone has no open items (except the release epic) and integrates it into the build/release specifications and the release contract. The new `scripts/check_milestone_cut.sh` properly checks the open PRs/issues and handles the epic exception. The `docs/specifications/06x-release-schedule.md` and `APR-RELEASE-001-train-and-build-kaizen.md` have been properly updated to call this script at freeze and prior to the tag cut. The contract includes the new constraints and tests correctly. The self-test logic effectively tests the required edge cases as stated in the receipt. I found no evidence that the gate is weakened, tests assert the opposite, or claims are unsubstantiated. The implementation is well-tested and documented.

Independent Review (Lane 2 of 3) for ticket PMAT-3445:

VERDICT: PASS.

1. Ticket Alignment:
The diff directly addresses PMAT-3445 ("release train: a tag was cut while its milestone had open issues — 0.68.0 shipped with 2 open, one a user-faci") by adding `scripts/check_milestone_cut.sh` as an automated gate checking that the milestone has no open issues or pull requests at the instant of the cut (except the train's own release epic, which is closed post-publish at step 8). The gate is integrated into `docs/specifications/06x-release-schedule.md` (§4 steps 1 and 4), `docs/specifications/APR-RELEASE-001-train-and-build-kaizen.md` (§4 T-0 and T-3), and `contracts/release-schedule-06x-v1.yaml` (equation `milestone_settled_at_cut`, invariant `RS0-INV-007`, falsification tests `FALSIFY-REL-06X-009/010`, and `qa_gate.checks`).

2. Refutation Criteria Checks:
- Test asserting opposite of ticket: None. All 25 self-test cases in `check_milestone_cut.sh` assert that unsettled open issues/PRs, count discrepancies, ambiguous epics, or missing milestones fail the cut (exit 1 or exit 2).
- Gate weakened: None. Contract quality gate and release specifications were strengthened with mandatory pre-freeze and pre-tag checks.
- Receipt claim not backed by diff: None. All files, specifications, equations, and test cases claimed in the receipt are present in the diff.
- Unasked changes: None. All diff changes are strictly scoped to the ticket requirements and audit trails.

3. Measured Verifications:
- `bash scripts/check_milestone_cut.sh --self-test` (and bare run): exit 0, 25 cases passed.
- All 5 mutations verified RED:
  (a) Judge always passes: exit 1 (S2, S3, S4, S12, S15, S16, S18, S19, S20, S21, S23 RED)
  (b) Count cross-check deleted: exit 1 (S6, S7 RED)
  (c) `--paginate` dropped: exit 1 (S15 RED)
  (d) Release-epic admission removed: exit 1 (S17, S22, S23 RED)
  (e) Admission widened to any epic: exit 1 (S18, S20, S21 RED)
- `bashrs lint --no-ignore --level error`: exit 0 (0 issues found).
- `pv validate contracts/release-schedule-06x-v1.yaml` & `pv lint`: exit 0, 0 errors, 0 warnings (PASS).
- `cargo test -p aprender-core --test readme_contract`: exit 0 (15 passed).
- `cargo test -p aprender-contracts --lib`: exit 0 (1538 passed).
- `cargo deny check advisories`: exit 0 (`advisories ok`).
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: exit 0.

No refuting findings found.

Reviewed PMAT-3445 diff against ticket requirements and receipt. The diff introduces scripts/check_milestone_cut.sh to prevent cutting tags when a milestone contains open issues or pull requests, updates the release specifications (06x-release-schedule.md and APR-RELEASE-001) to make pre-tag checks binding, updates the release schedule contract (release-schedule-06x-v1.yaml), and records the audit plan, receipt, and estimates. All 25 self-test cases and 5 mutation test suites pass as claimed. No refuting flaws found. Verdict: PASS.
